notes.title: Alpine - The Simulation Game | Update 1.18
notes.notes:
A new update for Alpine - The Simulation Game is now available. 

The achievement "Night Owl" has been fixed and the PS4 and Steam versions are now on par thanks to some optimisations on the PS4. 

Among other things, the light artefacts on the Steiner lift have been fixed and there has also been a slight overhaul of the game world. 

We wish you lots of fun with the update! :)

notes.title: Alpine - The Simulation Game | Release Date
notes.notes:
Alpine - The Simulation Game will be released on 23th November 2021 for PlayStation 4 and PC. 

Get involved to help the guests of the idyllic mountain village of Oberbruck a skiing experience in a class of its own. Put on your skis and do your swings on the freshly groomed slope! Expand your ski area by mastering exciting challenges with different vehicles and unlock new slopes, lifts and areas of the game world.
All this will await you in "Alpine - The Simulation Game". 

To make sure you don't miss the release, add the game to your Steam Wishlist now and become part of our Discord: https://discord.gg/6nJkxQjdvR
